pages.title: The Hive Mountain
pages.summary: A young beekeeper follows the last queen into a hive that has grown into a mountain.
pages.body:
## Pitch
A young beekeeper follows the last queen into a hive that has grown into a mountain. The player climbs from the foothill apiary to the summit, through comb galleries that have swallowed ruins, roots and rain.

## Tone
Warm, drowsy and uneasy. Amber light, humming walls, wax that remembers. Quiet melancholy rather than horror: the hive is not evil, only grown too large and too lonely.

## Themes
- Stewardship and grief: caring for something that outgrew you.
- Growth without limit.
- Sweetness hiding hunger.

## Structure
A climb upward. Each region is a deeper layer of the hive: [[threshold_apiary]], [[waxen_stair]], [[honeywell_depths]], [[crown_comb]].

## Cast
- [[wanderer]], the young beekeeper.
- [[last_queen]], who leads the way.
- Hive creatures: [[crawler]] and [[charger]].

## Look and feel
Hexagonal geometry, dripping gold, pale wax, dark resin. Movement is a climber's: light, precise, and learned from the hive's own creatures.

pages.title: Wanderer
pages.summary: A young beekeeper who follows the last queen into the mountain hive.
pages.body:
Raised tending the foothill apiary, the Wanderer was the last keeper after the other hives fell silent. When the final queen slipped out one dawn and climbed into the mountain, they followed.

They are quiet, patient and stubborn. They don't speak. They fight with a hive tool and with the habits of a keeper: calm hands, careful steps.

See [[last_queen]], and the places they pass through: [[threshold_apiary]], [[waxen_stair]], [[honeywell_depths]], [[crown_comb]].

fields.appearance: Small and wiry, patched veil hat, smoke-stained gloves, a worn hive tool on the belt
fields.motivation: Bring the last queen home before her line ends

pages.title: The Last Queen
pages.summary: The final queen bee, who leads the Wanderer upward and may be the hive's captive or its heart.
pages.body:
She is glimpsed ahead more often than met: a spark of gold at the top of a shaft, a hum that fades around a corner.

The hive has grown for her sake, and it wants her back. Whether it protects her or keeps her is the question the climb answers in [[crown_comb]].

She is followed by the [[wanderer]]. The hive's creatures, [[crawler]] and [[charger]], are her unwilling guards.

fields.appearance: Palm-sized, pale gold, faintly glowing; a trail of light drifts behind her
fields.motivation: Return to the Crown Comb, where the hive began

pages.title: Crawler
pages.summary: A slow larva-like hive grub that creeps along walls and floors.
pages.body:
Crawlers are unfinished workers: the hive began shaping them and never stopped. They plod along comb and ceilings, and they turn at edges.

They teach the player to read terrain and time a jump. Found first in [[threshold_apiary]] and in great numbers in [[waxen_stair]]. They are kin to the [[charger]].

fields.appearance: Pale segmented grub with a wax-crusted back and dim amber eyes
fields.behavior: Patrols a surface back and forth; harmless unless touched
fields.habitat: Everywhere, most common in the Waxen Stair

pages.title: Charger
pages.summary: A heavy armored drone that spots the player and rushes straight at them.
pages.body:
Chargers are the hive's old guards, bred for one job. They can't fly any more, so they hit hard instead.

They punish standing still and reward sidestepping: dodge the rush and the Charger rams the wall. Common in [[waxen_stair]], [[honeywell_depths]] and [[crown_comb]]. See also the [[crawler]].

fields.appearance: Bulky dark-resin drone with a horned plated head and stunted wings
fields.behavior: Idles, then charges in a straight line when the player is in sight; stuns itself on walls
fields.habitat: Wide galleries and the approach to the crown

pages.title: Threshold Apiary
pages.summary: The foothill apiary where the journey starts, at the mountain's feet.
pages.body:
The [[wanderer]]'s home. Every box is silent but one: the [[last_queen]] has just left through a seam in the rock where wax has pushed out like a tongue.

The first enemies appear here, [[crawler]] grubs, and the first jumps are learned. Beyond the seam lies [[waxen_stair]].

fields.appearance: Rows of empty wooden hives, overgrown with wax that creeps up from a crack in the cliff

pages.title: Waxen Stair
pages.summary: Vertical comb galleries climbing the outer mountain, full of old ruins fused into wax.
pages.body:
The hive swallowed a mountain village; doors and rafters stick out of the comb like bones. Paths wind up through shafts and ledges.

Home to many [[crawler]]s and the first [[charger]]s. The climb ends where the wax turns dark and wet, at [[honeywell_depths]].

fields.appearance: Stacked hex chambers, fossilized beams, dripping gold, shafts of daylight through thin wax

pages.title: Honeywell Depths
pages.summary: Flooded amber caverns at the mountain's heart where the hive stores centuries of honey.
pages.body:
Honey here is old enough to hold images: the [[wanderer]] sees fragments of the hive's earlier queens in the amber.

[[charger]] guards patrol the ridges between the pools. The only way on is up, to [[crown_comb]], where the [[last_queen]] is heading.

fields.appearance: Glowing amber pools, hanging wax curtains, trapped insects like jewels in the walls

pages.title: Crown Comb
pages.summary: The summit chamber where the hive began and where the last queen goes.
pages.body:
The first cell of the hive, grown into a cathedral. The [[last_queen]] comes to rest here, and the hive's whole weight bears on this single room.

The approach is held by [[charger]] guards. The [[wanderer]] must choose whether to let the hive keep her, or to carry her home to [[threshold_apiary]].

fields.appearance: A huge open cell ringed by tiers of comb, lit from the peak by pale sky

pages.title: Drone Hollows
pages.summary: A side branch of old barracks where the hive's guard drones sleep, off the Waxen Stair.
pages.body:
Resin-dark tunnels branching from the [[waxen_stair]], where the hive kept its guards. The air is hot and still, the walls scarred by charges. The [[charger]] drones are common here.

A sealed brood door at the bottom holds the Hive Key, guarded by the oldest drone. The key opens the way to the [[crown_comb]].

fields.appearance: Dark resin tunnels, scarred walls, empty barracks cells
fields.role: Optional-looking branch that holds the key to the final region

items.name: Hive Key
items.description: It opens the way to Crown Comb.

modals.title: You got Comb Grip
modals.body:
Slide down walls you press against, and jump off them. Climbs a single wall by jumping off and steering back.

It opens the way to Drone Hollows and Honeywell Depths.

modals.title: You got Veil Glide
modals.body:
Hold jump while falling to fall slowly.

It opens the way to Crown Comb.

modals.title: You got Hive Key
modals.body: It opens the way to Crown Comb.

modals.title: The End
modals.body:
The summit chamber where the hive began and where the last queen goes.

Thanks for playing Untitled Game.

modals.body: A young beekeeper follows the last queen into a hive that has grown into a mountain.

rooms.name: Apiary Gate
rooms.notes: Start. Quiet wax-sealed entry hall with amber light and dripping honey. Safe space to learn movement.

rooms.name: Brood Corridor
rooms.notes: Long low corridor lined with empty brood cells; first crawlers.

rooms.name: Keeper's Nook
rooms.notes: Small resting alcove with a save point and a lone crawler.

rooms.name: Cell Shaft
rooms.notes: Short vertical shaft of stacked hexagonal cells; platforming over small drops.

rooms.name: Waxen Threshold
rooms.notes: Wide doorway hall where the apiary gives way to the stair; a crawler guards it.

rooms.name: Foot of the Stair
rooms.notes: Wax ramps begin to climb; first charger teaches dodging.

rooms.name: Candle Landing
rooms.notes: Wide landing of melted candle wax with two chargers and room to maneuver.

rooms.name: Spiral Rise
rooms.notes: Tall winding climb up the waxen stair; platforms spiral upward.

rooms.name: Midway Rest
rooms.notes: Save point on a broad step before the upper stair; two chargers patrol.

rooms.name: Fork of the Stair
rooms.notes: Junction high on the stair. A sheer wall to the depths needs Comb Grip; the guardian chamber lies on.

rooms.name: Grip Guardian's Chamber
rooms.notes: Arena of ribbed wax walls. The guardian crawler falls to yield Comb Grip.

rooms.name: Hollow Mouth
rooms.notes: Dark entrance into the drone tunnels, entered with Comb Grip. Walls to cling to.

rooms.name: Drone Tunnels
rooms.notes: Winding burrows with narrow tunnels and crawlers.

rooms.name: Sleeper's Hub
rooms.notes: Central cavern with a save point; a walled-off upper shaft leads to the Hive Key cache.

rooms.name: Husk Gallery
rooms.notes: Gallery of discarded drone husks; spike-lined pits.

rooms.name: Collapsed Cell
rooms.notes: Dead-end vertical chamber of collapsed comb; a loop back to the tunnels.

rooms.name: Syrup Descent
rooms.notes: Drop down a wall into amber honey depths; walls for clinging.

rooms.name: Amber Flats
rooms.notes: Wide flooded flats; golden light and crawlers.

rooms.name: Drip Chasm
rooms.notes: Chasm with dripping honey and sticky ledges.

rooms.name: Sunken Apiary
rooms.notes: Hub with a save point; a high wall leads to the Veil Glide cache.

rooms.name: Pollen Pits
rooms.notes: Spiked pits in drifting pollen.

rooms.name: Sealed Honeygate
rooms.notes: Great gate of hardened honey. Needs Veil Glide to cross the gulf and the Hive Key to open the lock.

rooms.name: Crown Gate
rooms.notes: Royal entrance with gilded wax pillars.

rooms.name: Gilded Cells
rooms.notes: Wide hall of gold-lined cells.

rooms.name: Courtier's Rest
rooms.notes: Tall chamber with the final save point.

rooms.name: Royal Ascent
rooms.notes: Final climb with hazards and crawlers.

rooms.name: Queen's Throne
rooms.notes: Throne of the comb; the ending lies here.

rooms.name: Veil Glide Cache
rooms.notes: Open vaulted chamber; its charger guardian yields Veil Glide.

rooms.name: Hive Key Cache
rooms.notes: Hidden royal larder; its charger guardian drops the Hive Key.

plan.summary:
planned 29 rooms, 32 links — I shaped the seeded plan into a 29-room world, and checkPlan is clean. I didn't queue a build.

- **Rooms:** Every room now has a name and a short note. I set terrain by region. The Apiary is gentle. The Stair is tall and climbing. The Hollows are dense, narrow tunnels. The Depths are wide and flood
